name: guard-coinbase-is-cold-at-berlin
rationale: EIP-3651 regression guard. The block coinbase must still be a COLD address at Berlin: the contract measures the gas a BALANCE of the coinbase costs and stores it, which is 2607 cold and 107 warm. Storing the measurement rather than asserting a bare success is what makes this a positive assertion. At Shanghai the same inputs give 0x6b.
source: synthetic (step 04 reviser, round 1) -- regression guard for a Shanghai behaviour that instruction.md forbids leaking backwards
